Method of Attack: Critical privilege escalation zero-day exploit in Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server
Creates arbitrary administrator accounts on exposed endpoints
Bypasses existing security checks using crafted HTTP requests
Stealthy compromise by suppressing setup completion notifications
Impacted Systems: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server versions 8.0.0 and later
Not vulnerable: Atlassian-hosted instances at atlassian.net domains
Indicators of Compromise: Four offending IP addresses shared by Microsoft on Twitter
Proof-of-concept exploit and technical details released by Rapid7
